Across four system variants and two datasets, the combi- nation of QD and reranking provided the largest gains, increasing retrieval and answer correctness, without requiring extra training or domain-specific tuning. Splitting a query into focused sub-queries broadened evidence coverage, while the reranker promoted the most relevant passages, yielding im- provements on benchmark datasets.
